listen.script: Look! This is a red ball.
Hello! My name is Sara. I am seven.

read.passage: This is Ali. He is six. He has a cat. The cat is white. Ali likes his cat.

speak.prompt: Hello! What is your name? How old are you?
speak.expect: The learner can give basic personal information using single words or memorised formulaic phrases (e.g., 'My name is Faisal.' / 'Seven.'). Speech may be slow, with pauses and heavy first-language influence on pronunciation. The learner relies on the examiner's slow, clear speech and may need repetition or gestures. Answering with name and age, even as single words, meets the band. Linking ideas or adding details is not expected.
